note: Rewritten from Krishna 1963 (American Museum Novitates 2161, The African genus Foraminitermes), the original in English; for this species the paper gives only the soldier measurement table (range) and one comparison sentence, with no body colour, pilosity or head-shape details, so this entry has measurements only; Holmgren 1912 described the species from the alate, the soldier being described here for the first time. Measurements are kept verbatim in mm; the original prints Height of head 1 .80—1.82 with an OCR gap, recorded here as 1.80—1.82.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is larger than in any species known at the time, with the anterior part of the head (frontal projection) more prominently projecting. Soldier head length (to the mandible base) 2.66—2.72 mm, head width 2.06—2.10 mm, head height 1.80—1.82 mm, postmentum length 1.73—1.80 mm, pronotal width 1.39 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (range, in mm): head length (to the lateral mandible base) 2.66—2.72; head width 2.06—2.10; head height 1.80—1.82; left mandible length 1.08; postmentum greatest width 0.68—0.69; postmentum least width 0.38—0.41; postmentum length 1.73—1.80; pronotum greatest length 0.68—0.70; pronotal width 1.39; hind tibia length 1.50—1.54. Compared with the soldiers of the species known at the time, this species is larger and its frontal projection is more prominently projecting. Type locality Lolodorf, Cameroon (3°15′ N, 10°40′ E).
